description: This source file contains the implementation of the FontHandler class, which provides static methods for converting and handling font objects within the MigraDoc rendering framework. It includes functionalities like converting DOM Fonts to XFonts, retrieving font styles and metrics, and caching fonts for performance optimization.

classes.name: FontHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for font measurement and conversion in rendering documents with MigraDoc.

methods.name: FontToXFont
methods.description: Converts a MigraDoc Font object to a PDFsharp XFont object, utilizing caching with WeakReferences to improve performance.

methods.name: GetXStyle
methods.description: Determines the appropriate XFontStyleEx enumeration value based on the font's bold and italic properties.

methods.name: GetDescent
methods.description: Calculates the descent metric for a given XFont, factoring in font size and metrics.

methods.name: GetAscent
methods.description: Calculates the ascent metric for a given XFont, factoring in font size and metrics.

methods.name: GetSubSuperScaling
methods.description: Returns a scaling factor (typically less than 1) for subscript/superscript font sizing based on the font's ascent.

methods.name: ToSubSuperFont
methods.description: Creates a scaled XFont suitable for subscript or superscript text, based on the original font.

methods.name: FontColorToXBrush
methods.description: Converts a MigraDoc Font's color to an XBrush, considering CMYK color models if applicable.
